item.title: Patch now: SignalWire FreeSwitch: Code Injection
item.description:
SignalWire FreeSwitch: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 1.11.3

First step: Update SignalWire FreeSwitch to 1.11.3 or later.

SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-116779
